body: Addressing the review of head2d5c371. Returning this existing PR to draft before any update, per current AGENTS.md. Plan: integrate authoritative upstream/main pinned5208e94015239c8c05c53b8d78e84f1a8cf6e3bf (our origin is the publishing fork); keep the whole-CrossHole traverse_s calls and upstream chord solver, retaining rapid() around radial rapids. Resolve the legacy ledger conflict by preserving upstream RECOMMENDED.md and moving only our #151 decision to docs/decisions/151-cross-drill-invariance.md, as current instructions require. Validate the requested cross_invariance, drilling_cross_box and drilling_cross_spindle suites, plus drilling library/off-centre traversal coverage and touched-crate Clippy. These are focused quick-tier checks for this integration-only revision; existing broad-suite receipts remain historical, with no redundant broad baseline/full-suite run. Independent incremental review, then one normal push to the same feature branch and re-mark ready after verification. No new PR, force-push, main merge or release.

Merged main into the branch (254a95c) to clear the conflicts:

- `crates/motion/src/drilling/cross.rs`: main (#209/#81) changed `traverse_s` to take the two holes instead of their directions. Both call sites now use main's signature and keep this PR's `rapid(&mut b, ..)` helper, so the 1e-9 mm rapid coalescing for #151 still applies.
- `RECOMMENDED.md`: main's version; this PR's entries moved verbatim to `docs/decisions/151-cross-drill-invariance.md` (one decision file per PR, AGENTS.md since #250).

Re-tested on the merged tree: motion lib `drilling` 34 passed, `cross_invariance` 2, app `drilling_cross_box` 7, `drilling_cross_spindle` 7, `drilling_cross_part` 3, `drilling_cross_holder` 2, `lathe_cross_drill` 5, `drill_reach` 6 - all green; clippy `-D warnings` on motion + app clean. Mergeable now. Still a draft - mark it ready when you are happy and it goes into the review queue.

Thanks for the integration. Preserved254a95c and published only the one-line decision-cost documentation follow-up asd0bb8d2d027e0f62c2919412817a7cdbac49efe9. Our independent native checks passed58 tests (motion drilling34, cross_invariance2, app cross_box7, cross_spindle7, cross_stock8 including #81), with all four Cargo exits0 and motion/app all-target Clippy -D warnings clean. Exact Git comparison confirms every non-documentation file in the final tree matches our tested integration tree; no redundant rerun for the Markdown-only edit. Independent functional review plus documentation closure have no remaining findings. PR body now identifies current versus historical receipts. Re-marked ready and read back OPEN/non-draft, base main5208e94, MERGEABLE/CLEAN, six scoped files; no hosted checks reported. This addresses the integration request on2d5c371. Final tree:e0c513137a51cfab6d47eeb7b0d52fdb9ca936fd. Maintainer approval/merge remains external; no auto-merge or protected-main merge performed.
